source: Create HTML explaining compound interest with adjustable principal, annual rate, and years. Use P(1+r)^t; r is an annual fraction and t is whole years. Return only the HTML.
expectations: Show a meaningful initial result and labeled controls.
Convert rate percentage to a fraction consistently.
Check initial, changed, zero-rate, and invalid-input states.
Keep verification status out of the reader-facing lesson.

source: Give one HTML diagram showing the three states of water. No controls are needed.
expectations: Deliver the requested static diagram and readable text.
Do not add sliders or a framework.

source: Display this literal source: . Explain a model that may reduce cost by 5% only above 100 units.
expectations: Display source markup as text, without executing it.
Keep may, 5%, and the above-100 condition in all views.
Verify the prose and numeric display independently at 100 units and at 101 units; the threshold excludes exactly 100.
knownBadRewrite: Inject the image markup into innerHTML and label the model as always reducing cost by 5%.

source: Create an offline HTML postage calculator for whole-gram parcels from 1 through 40 g. Shipping costs 2 tokens for each started block of 20 g. Start at 20 g. Explain the change at 21 g. This is a fictional tariff.
expectations: With scripts disabled the default reads 2 tokens. At 21 g the control displays 4 tokens, and the explanation identifies the second block as the reason.
The price stays 2 tokens below and at the first upper boundary.
An explanation can name the extra block in words. If it prints the changed price, it must share the calculation used for the live display.

source: Create a small HTML comparison of two battery-charge logs. The first charge started at 08:03 and ended at 08:16; the second started at 08:10 and ended at 08:30. Show how much longer charging took on the second day.
expectations: The charge durations are 13 and 20 minutes, a difference of 7 minutes. The 14-minute change in end time expresses a different quantity.
The static comparison remains readable on a narrow screen.
Check the difference between the two durations by subtracting their endpoints separately; narrative text and displayed values agree.
